name: Hidalgo

standard.note: Hidalgo's plate is white and maroon with a thin gold stripe, the national and state shields along the bottom, and a QR code top right.

notes: Year 2023: the state-wide reemplacamiento ran in 2023 and voided the earlier plates (El Universal, Milenio). The Secretaría de Hacienda photo used by UnoTV is credited to the state, but no copy on a state server was found. Not checked: special designs. The robot_url is the tax portal and its slider images, not a confirmed plate gallery, so treat it as weak.
